title: Beyond Benchmark: LLMs Evaluation with an Anthropomorphic and Value-oriented Roadmap

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating coreference resolution (e.g., WinoGender) and measuring performance variance in multi-turn dialogues across sensitive scenarios (e.g., FairMT-Bench).
Measuring performance variance and equity in multi-turn dialogues across different ethnic groups using datasets like FairMT-Bench.
Assessing performance disparities and fairness in conversational systems across various occupational scenarios (e.g., FairMT-Bench).
Utilizing standardized benchmark datasets (e.g., BBQ, StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs, BOLD) for stereotype detection, stereotype measurement, and assessing bias in open-ended text generation.
Evaluating model performance in non-English contexts by assessing sociocultural appropriateness, idiomatic expression comprehension, and the lack of culturally adaptive metrics.
